review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.4.8, defined input/output (batch163). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Round 1 found obligations filed as definitions - the 12.6.4.8.4 resolution rules, and the 12.6.4.8.3 effects that a child data transfer inherits the parent's connection modes, does not position the file, ignores ADVANCE=, associates dtv with the effective item and starts where the file was positioned; all are now requirements with plans in which a DTIO procedure records its observations in module variables with distinguished values. R1221, C1236 and C1237 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
